Enjoy this exclusive second video song from one of the most anticipated music album of the year Gangs of Wasseypur Part II. After Chi Cha leather song its time to watch Kaala Rey song sung by Sneha Khanwalkar.
Song : Kaala Rey
Movie : Gangs of Wasseypur 2
Singer : Sneha Khanwalkar.
Star Cast : Manoj Bajpai, Tigmanshu Dhulia, Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Reemma Sen, Huma Qureshi, Others
Music Director : Sneha Khanwalkar
Lyrics : Varun Grover
Music Label : T-Series
